environment.description: Deployed on a shared Linux host (Ubuntu 22.04) running as service account 'report-svc'. The SQLite database at /var/lib/reports/analytics.db is owned by report-svc with read-write permissions (0660). REPORT_TEMP_DIR is /tmp (world-writable, no sticky bit enforcement on symlinks due to disabled fs.protected_symlinks). The tool is invoked via a web API wrapper that passes user-controlled --template and --query arguments directly. No database access restrictions beyond filesystem permissions.
